name: Fluttershy's Cottage
author: modChad
description: Fluttershy's cottage rebuilt from Discopears' complete show-accurate room (CC BY-SA 4.0): a leafy show-style mound with a porch, tall chimney, flower boxes and lattice windows, a stable front door that opens in halves, kitchen, storeroom, stairs and a dressed loft with her own bed and a window that opens.
